column4: A photograph from a drone 1,500 feet above the farmland north of a small Pacific Northwest town at blue hour, looking south-southeast: the town's street grid and rooftops fill the middle of the frame with warm streetlights just coming on, flat green and gold fields and dark evergreen forest around it, and Mount Rainier rises huge behind the town on the horizon, its north face holding the last pink alpenglow against a deep clean blue sky, thin cool haze layering the foothills. Use the first attached image for the exact profile of Mount Rainier's north face and the second attached image for the layout of the town's street grid and the fields around it. Photoreal, crisp, full-frame camera at 35 mm, long exposure, no motion blur; the exact centre of the frame is calm low-contrast rooftops with nothing distinctive there; no people, no text, no logos, no signs, no vehicles near the camera.

A photograph from a drone 800 feet over the north edge of a small Pacific Northwest farm town on a clear cold autumn morning, looking south-southeast: Mount Rainier dominates the upper half of the frame, enormous and sharp, its glaciers lit white-gold by low morning sun with the north face in soft blue shadow, a few thin high clouds; the town's rooftops and tree-lined streets run across the middle of the frame; open green pasture with a plain wire fence line fills the lower third. Use the first attached image for the exact profile of Mount Rainier's north face and the second attached image for the layout of the town's street grid and the fields around it. Photoreal, crisp, full-frame camera at 50 mm, deep depth of field; the lower third is calm open pasture with nothing distinctive in it; no people, no animals, no text, no logos, no signs.

A photograph at a welder's eye level, standing at his workbench inside a small fabrication shop and looking straight out through the wide open roll-up bay door: the clean brushed-steel top of the bench fills the lower third of the frame, empty and flat, a welding helmet and a pair of gloves set at the far left edge; beyond the door, late golden-hour light, the rooftops of a small Pacific Northwest town across the fields and Mount Rainier rising huge and pink-lit behind it in a clear sky; the dark door frame and shop walls edge the view. Use the first attached image for the exact profile of Mount Rainier's north face. Photoreal, crisp, 35 mm, a slight warm flare from the door; the centre of the bench top is perfectly empty; no people, no text, no logos, no signs.
